faqs.answer: We accept most major PPO dental plans including Delta Dental, MetLife, and Cigna. Call our Roseville office at (916) 555-0142 to verify your specific plan before your visit.
We're located at 8200 Sierra College Blvd, Roseville, CA 95661 — in the Granite Bay/Roseville area of Placer County. Free parking is available in the lot in front of the building.
Routine cleanings and exams typically take 45–60 minutes. New patients should allow 90 minutes. Book online at granitebaydental.com/book or call during business hours.
For dental emergencies during business hours, call (916) 555-0142 and we'll prioritize same-day care when possible. After hours, leave a message and our on-call team will return your call.
